patch_description: Per the Gen 32 finding, the steeper e^-1.5 tilt paired with the 2W-1 window held the 0.62 score, and the sensitivity note suggests larger SG windows may buy additional smoothness (slope_changes and false_reversals are the weakest metrics) at a lag cost that the recency-weighted convolution may recover. I sweep the SG window from 2W-1 to 2W+3 with order-2 polynomials, keeping the proven e^-1.5 recency tilt and all convolution vectorized. The quadratic fit and recency weighting should absorb the extra group delay while the wider window further suppresses noise-induced slope reversals.
